title: Set up Tugra
createFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
welcomeBody: Let's get your instance ready in a few steps: create your owner account, set the basics, connect a server, and launch your first workload.
adminBody: The first account on this instance becomes the owner.
setupCodeHint: Shown by the installer in your terminal. It proves you're the one who set up this box.
name: Name
basicsBody: Optional, but recommended. You can change these later in Settings.
publicUrlHint: The address agents and browsers use to reach this hub, e.g. https://hub.example.com.
acmeEmailHint: Used to issue SSL certificates for your apps' domains.
serverBody: Give it a name — you'll get a one-line command to run on the machine.
localServerBody: This machine is being connected automatically — no command to run.
runThisCommand: Run this on your server, then wait here:
waitingForServer: Waiting for the server to connect…
reissueHint: The enroll command expired before the server connected.
workloadBody: Deploy an app from a Git repository, or install one in a click from the app store.
doneBody: Your instance is ready. Manage everything from the dashboard.
